dedupe_keys.name: truc vert long term beach topography and forcing

description: The Truc Vert coastal survey team publishes a sixteen-year beach-topography collection through the Open Science Framework. The public project contains NetCDF survey files, an astronomical-tide series labelled 2000–2020 and a small Analysis.zip companion archive. The study site is the high-energy sandy beach at Truc Vert in France. These observations can support calibration of beach-profile and shoreline-change simulations, including model-xbeach applications examining coastal-defence exposure. The repository and DOI metadata state CC0, with free access to the deposited files. A caveat is that the own project description is short and does not establish uniform survey intervals, complete spatial coverage or measurement uncertainty. Those properties need checking against the file metadata and survey documentation before calibration. The analysis archive was not opened, so its programming language and executability remain unverified. No survey data were downloaded.
